description: This file defines the RefreshTokenEntity class, which implements the RefreshTokenEntityInterface for OAuth2 token management. It handles refresh token properties such as identifier, expiry time, and associated access token within an OAuth server implementation in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: RefreshTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents a refresh token entity used for OAuth2 token refresh process, implementing necessary interface and managing token data such as identifier, expiration, and associated access token.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the refresh token's identifier string.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the refresh token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time of the refresh token, overriding it to be in UTC and based on server TTL.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Associates an access token entity with this refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the associated access token entity.
